title: TbCu7 Stability Screen: validation of public DFT databases against observed metastable phases in Sm-Fe-M alloys (stability proxy table)
description: Compares energy above hull and computed Fe moments from Materials Project, AFLOW, JARVIS-DFT, NOMAD (Alexandria PBE), OQMD and GNoME with phases and magnetization observed in Sm-Fe and Sm-Fe-M alloys after rapid solidification or milling. Includes the stability proxy table (TbCu7 estimated from ordered CaCu5, 2:17, 3:29 and ThMn12 parents), the validation matrix, raw snapshots with provenance, curated literature observations with DOIs, pipeline code and documentation.
notes: Snapshot of database values: 2026-10-13. Code MIT; data CC BY 4.0.
